name: The White
summary: **The White** is a [[kind:cut|clone-only]] cut of undisclosed three-way parentage, first grown by a breeder known as Krome under the working name "Triangle." It was renamed for the pale, trichome-dusted look of its finished buds, and Krome has said only that it has no relation to [[white-widow|White Widow]]. It placed second in the Indica category at the 2009 IC 420 Growers Cup and is still passed on only as cuttings.
